### The Sting of Death
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sting-death
Passage: Hosea 13:14
Points:
- Death is not intrinsically good, but God temporarily ordained it to display His ultimate triumph.
- God's covenant judgments against Israel were designed not as final ends, but to purge and preserve a remnant.
- The Lord allowed death and exile to fall on the nation so life could emerge on the other side.
- In God's redemptive plan, death paradoxically becomes the pathway leading to new life.
- The Apostle Paul reveals that Christ's resurrection provides the ultimate fulfillment and defeat of death's sting.
